nodes.name: Process One Topic at a Time

parameters.text:
=Write an engaging, authoritative, well-researched 500-word editorial article for EveryGyan about: {{ $json.topic }}.

Category: {{ $json.category }}

Include:
1. A compelling H1 headline.
2. An engaging introduction paragraph.
3. 3-4 structured body sections with H2 subheadings, bullet points, and key takeaways.
4. A forward-looking conclusion.

Return strictly valid Markdown.

=Based on this article about "{{ $('Prepare Topic Context').item.json.topic }}", create a detailed, visual image generation prompt (under 50 words) for a modern, clean editorial infographic and visual summary.

Article excerpt: {{ ($json.text || $json.content || '').slice(0, 600) }}

Style guidelines:
- Modern vector editorial infographic or high-resolution illustration
- Minimalist geometry, clean typography, soft balanced colors, 16:9 widescreen
- Professional publication quality, no clutter, no distorted text

Output ONLY the prompt text.
